summary: Applied Digital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC completed a $1.59B private offering of 7.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 under Rule 144A/Regulation S. The notes were issued at par, with semi-annual amortization and interest, maturing in June 2031. Proceeds will fund 150MW AI factory construction in North Dakota, repay a bridge loan from Goldman Sachs Bank USA, establish debt service reserves, and pay expenses. This is a standard debt financing to support capital expenditures, not a change-of-control or special situation event. No actionable event-driven catalyst or structural complexity changes classification.
